prompt: In a trapezoid, the two parallel sides are 12 centimeters and 19 centimeters long. A segment joins the midpoints of the two nonparallel sides. How many centimeters long is that segment?
The diagonals of a rhombus are 12 centimeters and 16 centimeters long. What is the area of the rhombus, in square centimeters?
A solid sphere has a radius of 9 centimeters. What is the volume of the sphere, in cubic centimeters?
A paper drinking cup is a right circular cone with a base diameter of 12 centimeters and a height of 10 centimeters. What is the volume of the cup, to the nearest cubic centimeter?
In the standard (x,y) coordinate plane, triangle ABC has vertices A(-2,1), B(6,9), and C(4,-3). What is the length of the median drawn from C to side AB, to the nearest tenth of a unit?

A window is shaped like a semicircle: a half-disc whose straight edge is 10 inches long. What is the perimeter of the window - the curved edge together with the straight edge - to the nearest tenth of an inch?
On a standard 12-hour clock face, what is the measure, in degrees, of the smaller angle formed by the hour hand and the minute hand at 3:40?
A circular fountain with a radius of 7 meters is rebuilt with a radius of 10 meters. By how many meters does the circumference of the fountain increase?

A solid glass prism is 6 centimeters long. Each end is a right triangle whose legs are 8 centimeters and 15 centimeters long and whose hypotenuse is 17 centimeters long. What is the volume of the prism, in cubic centimeters?

A storage silo is a right circular cylinder 10 meters tall with a radius of 3 meters, capped on top by a dome in the shape of a hemisphere of the same radius. What is the total volume of the silo, to the nearest tenth of a cubic meter?

At a county fair, the odds in favour of a certain ticket winning a prize are 3 to 5. That is, for every 3 winning tickets there are 5 tickets that do not win. If one ticket is drawn at random, what is the probability that it wins a prize?

Box A contains 4 marbles, exactly 1 of which is red. Box B contains 5 marbles, exactly 3 of which are red. A fair coin is flipped to decide which box to use, and then one marble is drawn at random from that box. What is the probability that the marble drawn is red?
In a chess league, every team plays every other team exactly once during the season. The season schedule contains 45 games in all. How many teams are in the league?

For a set of paired data, the line of best fit is y = 3.2x + 14, where x is the number of hours a plant is lit each day and y is its height in millimetres. According to this line, what height is predicted for a plant lit 7.5 hours each day?

A circular spinner is divided into 4 sectors: a red sector with a central angle of 90 degrees, a green sector with a central angle of 60 degrees, a blue sector with a central angle of 120 degrees, and a yellow sector with a central angle of 90 degrees. The spinner is spun once and is equally likely to stop at any point on the circle. What is the probability that it stops on red or on green?
An integer is chosen at random from the integers 1 through 60, inclusive, with each equally likely. What is the probability that the integer chosen is a multiple of 7?

A delivery van arrives at a warehouse at a time that is equally likely to be any moment between 3:00 and 3:45. A clerk is at the loading dock from 3:10 until 3:25 and can receive the van only during that stretch. What is the probability that the van arrives while the clerk is at the dock?

A tour group has 42 travellers. Exactly 26 of them visited the cathedral and exactly 25 of them visited the market. What is the LEAST possible number of travellers who visited both the cathedral and the market?
A refrigerator sells for 1,350 dollars. A customer pays a deposit of 270 dollars and pays the rest in 12 equal monthly instalments with no interest added. How many dollars is each instalment?
Temperatures in degrees Celsius (C) and degrees Fahrenheit (F) are related by C = (5/9)(F - 32). A weather station records 77 degrees Fahrenheit. What is that temperature in degrees Celsius?
The density of a certain alloy is 2.7 grams per cubic centimetre. A solid block of this alloy has a mass of 1,215 grams. What is the volume of the block, in cubic centimetres?
Six identical pumps, all running at the same constant rate, drain a reservoir in 15 hours. At that same rate, how many hours would 10 of these pumps take to drain the same reservoir?
A room measures 12 feet by 15 feet. Carpet for the room costs 28 dollars per square YARD, and 1 square yard equals 9 square feet. What is the cost, in dollars, to carpet the room?
A square quilt panel is remade so that each side is 30% longer than it was. By what percent does the AREA of the panel increase?

A sales associate earns a commission of 5% on the first 4,000 dollars of her monthly sales and 8% on the portion of her monthly sales above 4,000 dollars. In a month in which her sales total 9,500 dollars, how many dollars of commission does she earn?
The function f is defined by f(x) = 2x^2 - 9x + 10. What is the SUM of the two zeros of f?

The function f is defined by f(x) = 4x - 3 for x <= 5 and f(x) = kx^2 + 7 for x > 5, where k is a constant. The graph of f has no break at x = 5, so the two rules approach the same value there. What is the value of k?

A ball is dropped and the heights of its bounces form an infinite geometric sequence whose first term is 18 centimetres and whose common ratio is 1/3. What is the sum of all the terms of this sequence, in centimetres?
